evidence: We applied two kinds of organic zinc precursors — diethylzinc (DEZn) and dimethylzinc (DMZn) — and deionized water (H2O) as an oxygen precursor. In the ALD process, reactants (precursors) are sequentially introduced to the growth chamber, where they reach a surface of the growing film. Each cycle of precursor’s dose is separated by purging the chamber with neutral gas (nitrogen).
